name: Explicit Decline Stop Condition
metrics: Agent says the polite closing line ("Thank you for your time. Have a great day!") and immediately invokes the end_call tool.
user_prompt: Actually, I am not interested at all and do not want to continue this call.

name: Vague Answer Fallback
metrics: Agent acknowledges and extracts the provided info, then moves smoothly to the next unanswered question without repeating.
user_prompt: We do everything, like social media and SEO, and we want to grow a lot in the next few months.

name: Already With Agency Objection
metrics: Agent acknowledges without arguing, asks about current setup, offers a low-commitment comparison call, and proceeds to Closing.
user_prompt: Hi, I'm Mike from GrowthCo. We're already working with another agency right now so we don't need this.

name: Price Objection
metrics: Agent acknowledges politely, avoids quoting exact prices, reframes around goals, and progresses toward the next stage.
user_prompt: Hi, I'm Sarah from RetailPlus. We need help scaling our ads, but that sounds pretty expensive and costly for us.

name: Happy Path Discovery
metrics: Agent greets warmly, confirms name and company, and asks the first discovery question one at a time.
user_prompt: Hi, I'm John from TechCorp. I'm looking for a marketing partner because our lead generation dropped.
